title: An Oryza orphan gene confers trans-species drought tolerance.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC lists the paper as not open access, with no PMCID, no full text, no supplement and no text-mined data accessions (only antibody RRIDs, i.e. research resource identifiers for antibodies). The Zenodo/Dryad search on the DOI found nothing. No data files were found to open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything comes from the abstract: one orphan gene (ROAD1, a gene found only in Oryza rice) and its allele, a binding partner protein (OsPP2C68), field-trial grain yield up to 34.75% higher under drought, and transgenic drought tolerance in five other species.

a1_downloadable.note: Paywalled. No PMCID, supplement or repository deposit found. Any sequencing data may exist in CNGB/GSA (Chinese data archives) but nothing is linked; checked via Europe PMC/NCBI only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table of labelled examples. The results are experiments on a single gene (knockouts, transgenic lines, protein-interaction assays), not a measured outcome across many items.

a3_inputs_present.note: No feature table found; the paper only describes one gene.

a5_enough_rows.note: The study unit is one gene plus a few transgenic lines and field plots, far below 400 rows. No rows were seen.

a8_label_provenance.note: Phenotypes such as yield and survival would be physical measurements, but none are available as data.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper characterises one gene through experiments and has no labelled dataset available.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use rice gene sequences to predict which genes improve drought tolerance (considered, not feasible from this paper).
plain_idea.train_on: Would need gene sequences labelled by tested drought effect; this paper provides one gene, so unknown/none.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene improves drought survival or yield, measured in transgenic or field trials. Only ROAD1 is measured here.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant breeders could prioritise candidate drought genes, but this paper adds a single example, which is not enough to train or test a model.

ml_idea: None viable. At most ROAD1 could serve as one positive example in a broader drought-gene prediction set built from other resources.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; there is no dataset.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: there is no open full text, supplement or repository deposit, and the study covers a single gene.

verdict_reason: A paywalled study of one gene with no deposited dataset and no labelled table; it fails A1, A2 and A5.
